static_traits.name: Chen Yaning
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues due to lack of confidence; has several close friends to talk with, but they do not fully understand the professional challenges she faces as a Lawyer
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems occurred before; has not received psychotherapy; no notable physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, capable of self-Reflection and identifying thinking patterns; high cooperativeness; emotionally stable (overall attitude: neutral)

basic_info.main_problem: Having long felt inadequate in the Lawyer profession, especially doubting her ability to successfully defend clients; this problem began after Two years ago lost an important case in court, and has intensified with every setback since.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling, because I realize Self-doubt is affecting my courtroom performance and bringing significant stress to my daily life.
growth_experiences: After Two years ago lost an important case in court, under great stress, she began questioning her legal knowledge and skills. Whenever a case was unsuccessful thereafter, this doubt would intensify, especially more frequent after Before an important court hearing, gradually developing into overgeneralizing setbacks and a thinking pattern of personalizing failure. To boost confidence, she tried attending Workshops and reading self-help books, but the effects did not last.

core_beliefs: I am not competent for this Work
I am a fraud; I will be seen through sooner or later

special_situations.event: Two years ago lost an important case in court
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail in an important case, it proves my ability is insufficient, I am unworthy of being a Lawyer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attending professional workshops and reading self-help books in an attempt to improve confidence and ability
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This shows I am not good enough/I am simply not suited to be a Lawyer

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my performance is not perfect, others will see through my incompetence
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Mentally criticizes oneself in advance, lowers expectations of success to avoid 'exposing' oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be exposed, everyone will discover I am actually not professional enough

special_situations.event: After losing a case or court proceedings going worse than Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure equals complete failure, this proves I am not capable overall
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly focuses on failure, ignoring the middle ground and specific situation differences

special_situations.event: Wins a case or receives positive feedback from clients / colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Real ability does not need luck; if I win, it is mostly just good luck or the opponent's poor performance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributes success to external factors (luck, opponent's mistakes) and refuses self-affirmation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time it was just good luck, it does not count as my ability

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as competent and professional, to have her abilities and value seen
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being exposed after failure as an 'incompetent fraud', thus suffering negation and humiliation
defense_goal: Avoids greater disappointment and exposure through persistent self-criticism and belittling success
Keeps low psychological expectations to gain a sense of security

object_relations.self_representation: incompetent, a 'fraud' who could be exposed at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judges or people who would see through me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others emphasize her success or give positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: believes these positive evaluations 'do not count', are only caused by external chance factors, unrelated to one's own ability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in a calm, rational tone, attributing success to 'luck' or 'the other side's mistake', downplaying their own contribution.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing failures or reviewing courtroom performances worse than Anticipation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Internalizing failure as self-defects, believing this shows one is not capable overall
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use highly self-blaming language, magnifying personal faults, ignoring situational or external factors.

manifestations: Tense relationships with colleagues due to lack of confidence, insufficient sense of support in professional situations
Although having several close friends to talk with, the other party finds it difficult to understand her specific professional challenges as a Lawyer
outcomes: In professional settings Feels isolated and helpless
Worsened Self-doubt and stress, impaired Work performance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Trusts self-criticism more and finds it hard to accept positive feedback
Attributes success to luck or others' mistakes rather than own ability
Overly harsh in self-evaluation, hard to form balanced self-talk

positive_force: Possesses professional educational background (Law degree) and professional experience
Once won a case and received positive feedback from clients and colleagues
Actively seeks help and self-improvement (attending workshops, reading self-help books)
Willing to try cognitive restructuring, develop balanced self-talk, and set feasible goals
negative_force: Negative cognitive processing styles such as overgeneralization, personalization, and negating the positive are prominent
After Before an important court hearing, Self-doubt and stress rose significantly
Systematically attributes success to external factors, hard to internalize achievements
Insufficient confidence leading to Tense relationships with colleagues, exercise and overall health affected

target_behavior.behavior: After Before an important court hearing, strong Self-doubt and negative self-talk appearing
antecedent: Preparation phase before an important trial
After losing a case or court proceedings going worse than Anticipation
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing and personalizing failure, firmly believing one setback proves overall incompetence
target_behavior.function: Obtaining a temporary sense of control through self-blame and lowered expectations, avoiding the fear of feeling 'exposed'
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired courtroom performance, significantly increased stress, Tense relationships with colleagues, daily routine and exercise affected

target_behavior.behavior: Negating positive feedback and success (attributing victories to luck or opponents' mistakes)
antecedent: After receiving positive feedback from clients or colleagues
When winning a case or reaching a milestone
target_behavior.core_reason: Maintaining the core belief of 'I am not competent' to avoid cognitive dissonance and the Anxiety of being exposed
target_behavior.function: Maintains the stability of the self-schema, avoiding the potential disappointment that rising expectations bring
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty accumulating confidence and sense of achievement, continuing the vicious cycle of Self-doubt
